review_delivery: Independent source review and final delta/rubric confirmation delivered through collaboration messages.
checks: The actual PadicInt 2 coefficient object satisfies DVR, characteristic zero and maximal-ideal adic completeness.
Both full symmetric orthogonal idempotent decompositions are constructed; V has a proved two-sided inverse, correct congruence and all intertwining equations.
The no-solution proof excludes all orthogonal intertwiners, not merely scalar normalizations of V.
Cancellation of 2 uses the domain/characteristic-zero properties, not invertibility of 2.
The first-column obstruction is sent through the actual reduction ring homomorphism to ZMod 8.
The candidate task gives actual data and the main goal; it contains no dyadic, square-class, Hensel or polar-decomposition hint.
Any complete legal short counterexample resolves the universal target; no additional general classification is hidden in the rubric.

formalization.scope: Complete actual-data counterexample including every task hypothesis and nonexistence of the requested comparison; all mathematical claims in the reference are covered.

author_stage_note: design.json records the author-stage assessment; this review is the later independent acceptance.
